definitionZh: 边框- 底色 CSS 属性设置元素底边框的颜色 。 也可以用短手的 CSS 属性边框颜色或边框底设置.
sourceDefinition: The border-bottom-color CSS property sets the color of an element's bottom border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-bottom.
